<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">Dear Mr. Fahrh&ouml;fer,</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">you have asked me to evaluate the global distribution rights for MEDUSA
on the basis of the future economic benefits to be achieved for the CS Diagnostics Group as of <B>April 1, 2025 </B>(valuation date).
I would like to comment on this as follows:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0%"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in">1.</TD><TD>Description of the Intangible Asset: Global Distribution Rights
                                            for MEDUSA</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">The intangible asset under evaluation consists of the exclusive global
distribution rights for the surface disinfectant MEDUSA. These rights grant the holder the sole authorization to market and distribute
the product within the target regions of North America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia / Pacific. The exclusivity is contractually
secured for the full economic life cycle of the product, which is estimated at 20 years based on potential technological advancements
and the emergence of microbial resistance.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0%"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in">a)</TD><TD>Product Description and Areas of Application</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">MEDUSA is a non-alcohol-based surface disinfectant available in various
container sizes (e.g., 30 ml, 250 ml, 500 ml, 1 liter) as well as in the form of pre-moistened wipes. The product was developed by CS
Interpharm LLC, a company of the CS Diagnostics Group, and is intended for the hygienic cleaning of surfaces in professional settings,
particularly in:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">-</TD><TD>Hotel operations</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">-</TD><TD>Food service establishments</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">-</TD><TD>Public institutions such as schools, childcare facilities, sports
                                            venues, airports, and hospitals and for use by end consumers in private households.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: right; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><IMG SRC="wrankmore_footer.jpg" ALT="">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 1 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 8pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 2px solid"><TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font-size: 10pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: left"><TD STYLE="width: 33%">&nbsp;</TD><TD STYLE="width: 34%; text-align: center"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 33%; text-align: right">&nbsp;</TD></TR></TABLE></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 8pt"><TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%"><TR><TD STYLE="text-align: left; width: 100%"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 8pt">&nbsp;</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">According to the manufacturer, the product exhibits antibacterial,
antiviral, and antifungal properties. As it does not contain alcohol, MEDUSA is not classified as a hazardous substance under applicable
regulations. This may offer advantages in terms of storage, transport, and handling safety, especially for frequent use by personnel
without the need for specialized protective equipment.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">A notable product characteristic, as reported by the provider, is
the ability to analytically detect the presence of the substance on treated surfaces up to 10 days after application. It is explicitly
noted, however, that this detection does not imply any proven duration of antimicrobial efficacy or protective effect during this period.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0%"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in">b)</TD><TD>Intellectual Property and Development Status</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">MEDUSA was developed by CS Interpharm LLC. The product formulation
is not protected by a patent, and according to company statements, no patent application is planned. The rationale given is that patenting
would require public disclosure of the formulation. Protection of the product is therefore based on:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">-</TD><TD>Confidential knowledge (know-how) concerning its composition and
                                            manufacturing</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">-</TD><TD>Regulatory approvals in selected markets (e.g., Europe and the Middle
                                            East)</TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">-</TD><TD>Use of the brand name &ldquo;MEDUSA&rdquo;</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0%"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in">c)</TD><TD>Scope of Distribution Rights</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">The distribution rights under evaluation include:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0%"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in">-</TD><TD>Exclusive rights to distribute all current and future variants of
                                            the MEDUSA product</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0%"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in">-</TD><TD>Commercial use of the existing product name</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0%"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in">-</TD><TD>Utilization of existing and future regulatory approvals in the defined
                                            territories</TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0%"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in">-</TD><TD>Exclusivity against third parties within the contractually defined
                                            regions</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">Utilization of the rights takes place within a regulated market environment,
with varying approval processes depending on the region. Regulatory authorizations are already in place for Europe and the Middle East.
According to the information provided, applications for approval in North America are currently in progress, while evaluation for the
African and Asian / Pacific markets is ongoing.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 8pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 2px solid"><TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font-size: 10pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: left"><TD STYLE="width: 33%">&nbsp;</TD><TD STYLE="width: 34%; text-align: center"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 33%; text-align: right">&nbsp;</TD></TR></TABLE></DIV>

    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0%"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in">2.</TD><TD>Market Competition</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0%"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in">a)</TD><TD>Market Overview by Region</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">The surface disinfectant market in MEDUSA's target regions is characterized
by internationally established suppliers whose products differ in terms of active ingredients, fields of application, and pricing. The
main competing products by region are:</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0%"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD><B>Europe</B>:
                                            Mikrozid&reg; (Sch&uuml;lke &amp; Mayr), Sagrotan&reg; (Henkel), Domestos&reg; (Unilever),
                                            Incidin&reg; (Ecolab), Sterillium&reg; Protect &amp; Care (Hartmann Group)</TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0%"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD><B>North
                                            America</B>: Lysol&reg; (Reckitt Benckiser), Oxivir&reg; TB (Diversey), Peroxide Multi Surface
                                            Cleaner (Ecolab), Clorox&reg; (Clorox Company)</TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0%"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD><B>Middle
                                            East / Africa</B>: Domestos&reg;, Dettol&reg; (Reckitt Benckiser), Clorox&reg;, Oxivir&reg;,
                                            Incidin&reg;</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">Most of these products are based on <B>alcoholic, chlorine-based,
or oxidative active substances</B>, such as ethanol, sodium hypochlorite, hydrogen peroxide, or quaternary ammonium compounds (QACs).
These ingredients typically offer <B>rapid disinfection effects</B>, but they are generally <B>volatile</B>, <B>irritating</B>, or <B>classified
as hazardous substances</B>. As a result, special handling and storage precautions are often required.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">Application areas range from professional settings (e.g., hospitals,
food processing, public institutions) to private use (e.g., Sagrotan, Sterillium).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">MEDUSA is thus positioned in the <B>mid-price segment </B>- above
entry-level mass-market products (e.g., Domestos, Clorox), but <B>significantly below premium brands </B>such as Sagrotan or Sterillium.
In combination with relatively low production costs, this results in an <B>average gross margin of approximately 72 to 74&#8239;%</B>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">In comparison to standard market products, the following distinguishing
features and potential advantages of MEDUSA can be identified:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">One key advantage of MEDUSA in professional settings is the <B>potential
to reduce the frequency of application</B>. Since the product remains detectable on treated surfaces for up to 10 days, the number of
required disinfection cycles may be significantly reduced. By contrast, conventional disinfectants typically require <B>multiple daily
applications</B>, especially in high-traffic areas such as restrooms, reception zones, or communal spaces.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">This results in a <B>substantial savings potential in terms of labor
and staffing</B>, which are significant cost factors in professional cleaning and facility management.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0%"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><B>d)</B></TD><TD><B>Market Entry Barriers</B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">Despite its technical differentiation, various entry barriers must
be considered across all target regions:</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0%"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD><B>Regulatory
                                            hurdles</B>: Approval of biocidal products requires extensive documentation and testing,
                                            depending on regional requirements (e.g., EU BPR, U.S. EPA).</TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0%"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD><B>Brand
                                            loyalty</B>: Many institutional buyers maintain long-term supplier relationships and preferred
                                            vendor lists.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0%"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD><B>Established
                                            distribution and logistics structures</B>: Competitors benefit from mature networks, training
                                            programs, and service infrastructure.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0%"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD><B>Trust
                                            and credibility</B>: Market acceptance of new products depends on demonstrable efficacy,
                                            safety, and seamless integration into existing hygiene protocols.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">MEDUSA already holds regulatory approvals in Europe and the Middle
East. According to the CS Diagnostics Group, approval processes for North America are ongoing, and research is underway for entry into
African and Asian / Pacific markets.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0%"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><B>3.</B></TD><TD><B>Valuation of the Distribution Rights for MEDUSA</B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0%"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><B>a)</B></TD><TD><B>Total Market and Target Market</B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">The valuation of the exclusive global distribution rights for the
surface disinfectant MEDUSA is based on an assessment of the underlying addressable market. Relevant in this context are the markets
for professional surface disinfection in <B>Europe</B>, <B>North America</B>, <B>Middle East and Africa </B>and in <B>Asia / Pacific</B>,
where MEDUSA&rsquo;s product concept is aligned with regulatory frameworks, market structures, and application profiles.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">The available market data indicates steady growth in the coming years.
The aggregate size of the target market is projected to increase from <B>USD 5.46 billion in 2023 </B>to <B>USD 8.84 billion in 2030</B>,
representing a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of <B>7.1%</B>. In the same period, the global market is expected to grow to <B>USD
9.49 billion </B>(CAGR: <B>7.2%</B>). The regional development is summarized below:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

global market volume. The valuation is based exclusively on this portion of the market, as no market entry strategy is currently planned
for the remaining regions.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0%"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><B>b)</B></TD><TD><B>Volume Effect Due to Reduced Application Frequency</B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">One of MEDUSA&rsquo;s key product features is the <B>long-lasting
surface presence of the active ingredient</B>, which remains analytically detectable for up to 10 days. While this does not imply a verified
antimicrobial efficacy over that period, it may support a <B>reduction in disinfection frequency </B>in operational environments - especially
in standardized, high-traffic commercial facilities.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 6 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 8pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 2px solid"><TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font-size: 10pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: left"><TD STYLE="width: 33%">&nbsp;</TD><TD STYLE="width: 34%; text-align: center"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 33%; text-align: right">&nbsp;</TD></TR></TABLE></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 8pt"><TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%"><TR><TD STYLE="text-align: left; width: 100%"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 8pt">&nbsp;</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">Based on the target customer segmentation, the following distribution
and volume impact applies:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="border-bottom: black 1pt solid; width: 37%; text-align: center"><B>Segment</B></TD>
    <TD STYLE="border-bottom: black 1pt solid; width: 33%; text-align: center"><B>Share of Sales</B></TD>
    <TD STYLE="border-bottom: black 1pt solid; width: 30%; text-align: center"><B>Volume Effect</B></TD></TR>
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; background-color: rgb(204,238,255)">
    <TD STYLE="text-align: left">Hotels</TD>
    <TD STYLE="text-align: center">30.0%</TD>
    <TD STYLE="text-align: center">-50.0%</TD></TR>
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; background-color: White">
    <TD STYLE="text-align: left">Food Service</TD>
    <TD STYLE="text-align: center">30.0%</TD>
    <TD STYLE="text-align: center">0.0%</TD></TR>
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; background-color: rgb(204,238,255)">
    <TD STYLE="text-align: left">Other</TD>
    <TD STYLE="text-align: center">40.0%</TD>
    <TD STYLE="text-align: center">0.0%</TD></TR>
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; background-color: White">
    <TD STYLE="text-align: left"><B>Weighted Average</B></TD>
    <TD STYLE="text-align: center">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="text-align: center"><B>-15.0%</B></TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">In hotel operations, a reduction in application frequency appears
feasible due to standardized cleaning cycles in guest rooms. In food service and public institutions, however, disinfection is typically
integrated into broader cleaning routines, meaning no significant volume effect is expected in those segments. The <B>overall volume
effect is -15%</B>, which also supports MEDUSA&rsquo;s positioning in terms of time and cost efficiency.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0%"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><B>c)</B></TD><TD><B>Pricing and Cost Structure</B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">The economic valuation of the distribution rights is also based on
MEDUSA&rsquo;s pricing and cost structure. The product is offered in various unit sizes and as wet wipes. MEDUSA is positioned in the
<B>mid-price range</B>, while achieving an <B>average gross margin of 72.4% </B>due to its low production costs.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0%"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><B>d)</B></TD><TD><B>Discount Rate (Risk-Equivalent Interest Rate)</B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">To determine the present value of future cash flows, a <B>risk-adjusted
discount rate </B>is applied based on the Capital Asset Pricing Model (CAPM). Since the distribution right is treated as a standalone
intangible asset, the cost of equity is used as the relevant rate of return:&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="border-bottom: Black 1pt solid; white-space: nowrap; width: 25%; text-align: center"><B>Component</B></TD>
    <TD STYLE="white-space: nowrap; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid; width: 5%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="white-space: nowrap; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid; width: 15%; text-align: center"><B>Value</B></TD>
    <TD STYLE="white-space: nowrap; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid; width: 5%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="white-space: nowrap; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid; width: 50%; text-align: center"><B>Description</B></TD></TR>
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; background-color: rgb(204,238,255)">
    <TD STYLE="text-align: left">Risk-Free Rate</TD>
    <TD>&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="text-align: right">4.3%</TD>
    <TD>&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="text-align: left">10-year US Treasury Bonds</TD></TR>
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; background-color: White">
    <TD STYLE="text-align: left">Market Risk Premium</TD>
    <TD>&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="text-align: right">5.5%</TD>
    <TD>&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="text-align: left">US equity market assumption</TD></TR>

    <TD>&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="text-align: right">1.6</TD>

  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; background-color: White">

    <TD>&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="text-align: right"><B>13.9%</B></TD>
    <TD>&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="text-align: left">Applied as WACC for cash flow valuation</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">This rate reflects the risk profile of an early-stage, high-margin
health-related product without patent protection, but with proven differentiating product characteristics and partial regulatory approval.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0%"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><B>e)</B></TD><TD><B>Present Value of Future Cash Flows</B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-indent: -0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: left; margin-top: 0pt; margin-right: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt">The financial value of the distribution right is based
on the <B>discounted future free cash flows</B> derived from the exclusive commercialization of MEDUSA over a 20-year horizon (2025&ndash;2045).
The valuation assumes a gradual market penetration, with a market share of <B>0.1% in 2025</B> (beginning 4th Quarter of 2025), increasing
linearly to <B>3.0% from 2030 onward</B>, applied to the defined target market.</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-indent: -0.5in">&nbsp;&nbsp;</P>

    <TD STYLE="text-align: right">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="text-align: right">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="text-align: right"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><B>513</B></FONT></TD></TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-indent: -0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-indent: -0.5in">The <B>net present value (NPV)</B> of the distribution rights based on expected
cash flows and a discount rate of 13.9% amounts to <B>USD 513 million</B>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-indent: -0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-indent: -0.5in"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 8 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 8pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 2px solid"><TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font-size: 10pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: left"><TD STYLE="width: 33%">&nbsp;</TD><TD STYLE="width: 34%; text-align: center"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 33%; text-align: right">&nbsp;</TD></TR></TABLE></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 8pt"><TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%"><TR><TD STYLE="text-align: left; width: 100%"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 8pt">&nbsp;</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-indent: -0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0%"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><B>4.</B></TD><TD><B>Sensitivity Analysis</B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">The valuation of the global distribution rights for MEDUSA is based
on a number of assumptions and future expectations, the realization of which cannot be predicted with certainty. Two key variables have
a decisive impact on the resulting fair market value:</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0%"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in">1.</TD><TD>The <B>actual market share achieved </B>in the relevant geographical
                                            target markets (Europe, North America, Middle East and Africa, and Asia / Pacific)</TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0%"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><B>2.</B></TD><TD>The <B>efficiency gain for the end user</B>, resulting from
                                            reduced application frequency, which in turn affects the <B>sales volume and revenue potential</B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">While market share depends on factors such as regulatory approvals,
distribution reach, and customer acceptance in the professional segment, the volume effect stems from the fact that certain customer
groups - particularly in the hotel industry - may significantly reduce the number of daily disinfection applications. This has an impact
not only on product consumption but also on revenue generation. For this reason, a sensitivity analysis is necessary to explore various
combinations of these two factors.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">Sensitivity Matrix</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

based on different scenarios for the <B>final target market share (0.1% to 4.0%) </B>and the <B>volume reduction (0% to -30%)</B>:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>Interpretation of Results</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0%"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD><B>Base
                                            case</B>: The current valuation of <B>USD 513 million </B>is based on achieving a <B>3.0%
                                            market share </B>and a <B>weighted volume reduction of -15%</B>.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0%"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD>A
                                            market share 0.5 percentage points lower (i.e., 2.5%) under the same volume effect would
                                            result in a valuation of <B>USD 427 million</B> (-17%).</TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0%"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD>Conversely,
                                            if MEDUSA achieved a 4.0% market share with no volume reduction, the valuation would increase
                                            to <B>USD 804 million </B>(+57% compared to the base case).</TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0%"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD>A
                                            stronger efficiency effect (e.g., -25%) would further reduce revenues and result in a valuation
                                            of <B>USD 452 million </B>(at 3.0% market share).</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 9 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 8pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 2px solid"><TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font-size: 10pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: left"><TD STYLE="width: 33%">&nbsp;</TD><TD STYLE="width: 34%; text-align: center"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 33%; text-align: right">&nbsp;</TD></TR></TABLE></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 8pt"><TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%"><TR><TD STYLE="text-align: left; width: 100%"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 8pt">&nbsp;</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">This analysis highlights the <B>significant sensitivity of the valuation
to changes in market share and product usage efficiency</B>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0%"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><B>5.</B></TD><TD><B>Conclusion on the Fair Market Value of the Distribution
                                            Rights for MEDUSA</B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">Based on the available market analyses, product characteristics, financial
forecasts, and the discounted cash flow (DCF) valuation approach, an indicative valuation has been determined for the exclusive global
distribution rights to the surface disinfectant MEDUSA.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">The net present value of the projected cash flows over the economic
useful life of 20 years (2025-2045), assuming a <B>target market share of 3.0% </B>from the year 2030 and a <B>weighted volume effect
of -15 %</B>, amounts to <B>USD 513 million</B>. The calculation is based on a <B>risk-adjusted discount rate of 13.9 %</B>, derived
using the CAPM methodology and reflecting the product- and market-specific risk profile.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">The valuation is primarily influenced by the following factors:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0%"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD>the
                                            actual development of market share in the defined target regions (Europe, North America,
                                            Middle East &amp; Africa, Asia / Pacific)</TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0%"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD>the
                                            achievable efficiency gains for end users (e.g., reduced consumption due to less frequent
                                            application)</TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0%"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD>the
                                            pricing and margin structure across the different product variants</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0%"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD>the
                                            duration and stability of regulatory approvals in the respective regions</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">The sensitivity analysis presented in Section 4 illustrates the potential
range of valuation outcomes under varying assumptions. Depending on the realized market penetration and consumption efficiency, the fair
market value may range from approximately <B>USD 281 million </B>(2% market share with a 30% volume reduction) to <B>over USD 700 million
</B>(3-4% market share with lower volume loss or additional growth potential).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">Under the assumptions applied in this report, the <B>fair market value
of the distribution rights is estimated at approximately USD 513 million</B>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>
